request.spec:
A steward can undo the last merge into a person on the same sheet-today it was made (a button on
the row; PERSON_MERGE_UNDONE name=<the person restored> from=<the person merged into>): the merged
person is back at the end of the list with the claims that came from them (their numbers and
status as they are now) and their own aliases, which leave the other's; patron and pool changes
stay. Any later day, anyone else, or a person with no merge to undo is refused with an error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I've added undo-merge, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests (the main "merge undo" test and the three scenarios).

**How it works**
- **Button:** each person row now has an "Undo merge" button (`person-merge-undo`). A refusal shows its reason in the row's existing `person-error` element. After a successful undo, the people, claims, pools, crews and periods are all re-read, the same as after a merge.
- **What a merge now remembers:** each merge saves a record (new migration `V124__person_merge.sql`). It holds who merged whom into whom, who did it, the sheet-today it was done, and a copy of the merged person as they were just before the merge. It also lists the claims that moved over.
- **Undo** (`POST …/people/{id}/merge/undo`, in `PersonService.undoMerge`):
  - It works only on the most recent merge into that person. It is refused if that merge was already undone, or if the person has never had anything merged into them.
  - It is refused for anyone except the steward who made the merge, and on any sheet-today other than the one the merge was made on.
  - The merged person comes back with their original id, at the end of the list, with their grades, terms, tags and their own aliases. Their name and aliases are removed from the other person's alias list.
  - The claims that came from them go back to them as they are now, with their current numbers and status. Claims added to the other person after the merge stay where they are.
  - Patron, pool, crew, period, statement and snapshot changes made by the merge stay as they are.
  - It writes `PERSON_MERGE_UNDONE sheet=… by=… name=<restored> from=<other>`, followed by the usual ROLLUP and TOTALS lines.

**Choices the request didn't spell out**
- **Original id:** I put the person back under their original id by inserting the row directly with SQL, because the test expects their old `person-row-<id>`.
- **Merges through a transfer:** when a transfer merges someone into a person on another sheet, that counts as the last merge into them but can't be undone. So it blocks undoing any earlier merge into that person.
- **Holds, watchers and contact:** holds and watchers are not restored. The contact comes back only if nobody else on the sheet has taken it since.
- **Name clash:** if one of the merged person's names is now used elsewhere on the sheet or its tree, the undo is refused.
